items.title: Harold Danko interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 28, 2021
items.q: I came into a place where the first pianist was Hank.

ctx.x: “Groove Merchant.” Oh my — man, that’s like graduate school for saxophone players, right?

Oh yeah, yeah. There’s like, I mean it’s everything and the freedom I had because I came into a place where the first pianist was Hank. So there was not a lot written for piano. I just did a clinic where we talked about one of those charts, “Don’t Get Sassy.” And what I explained to some students was that Sam Herman was the original guitar player in the band. And those charts look like guitar charts because they’ve got every chord because Sam is playing four to the bar on a lot of those things. And piano players…
